actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Rahadin attacks three times with his scimitar, or twice with his poisoned darts.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d6 + 6) slashing damage.

actions.name: Poisoned Dart
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d4 + 6) piercing damage plus 5 (2d4) poison damage.

special_abilities.name: Deathly Choir
special_abilities.desc: Any creature within 10 feet of Rahadin that isn't protected by a mind blank spell hears in its mind the screams of the thousands of people Rahadin has killed. As a bonus action, Rahadin can force all creatures that can hear the screams to make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. Each creature takes 16 (3d10) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

special_abilities.name: Fey Ancestry
special_abilities.desc: Rahadin has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put him to sleep.

special_abilities.name: Mask of the Wild
special_abilities.desc: Rahadin can attempt to hide even when he is only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, and other natural phenomena.

special_abilities.name: Innate Spellcasting
special_abilities.desc: Rahadin's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence. He can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components: 1/day each: magic weapon, nondetection 3/day each: misty step, phantom steed
